propertySets.name: Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeFormedDuct
propertySets.definition: Space formed in the ground for the passage of pipes, cables, ducts.

properties.name: ClearWidth
properties.definition:
The clear width.

It indicates the formed space in the duct.

properties.name: ClearDepth
properties.definition:
The clear depth.

It indicates the formed space in the duct.

properties.name: WallThickness
properties.definition:
The thickness of the wall construction.
NOTE: It is assumed that walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: BaseThickness
properties.definition: The thickness of the base construction, assumed to be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: AccessCoverLoadRating
properties.definition: The load rating of the access cover (which may be a value or an alphanumerically defined class rating).

properties.name: CableDuctOccupancyRatio
properties.definition: Indicates the ratio between the number of cables in the duct and the maximum number of cables that the duct can contain.
